<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/discard_project_git_paths/{guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Throws away the unstaged working-tree changes to the given files in the
current user's dev clone of the project: a tracked file is restored to its
staged (index) copy, and an untracked file is deleted. Staged changes are
left alone. This cannot be undone.
